name: io.github.cyanheads/faa-airmen-registry-mcp-server
description: Search FAA airmen certificates, ratings, and informational medical records.

environmentVariables.name: FAA_AIRMEN_MIRROR_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Persistent local mirror directory; defaults to the platform user-data directory.

environmentVariables.name: FAA_AIRMEN_INCLUDE_LOCATION
environmentVariables.description: Opt in to city and ZIP import; display and filtering also need FAA_AIRMEN_REDACT_PII=false.

environmentVariables.name: FAA_AIRMEN_REDACT_PII
environmentVariables.description: Serving-time personal-data redaction, on by default; only 'false' turns it off.

environmentVariables.name: FAA_AIRMEN_STALE_AFTER_DAYS
environmentVariables.description: Source-age warning threshold in days, integer 1–366.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').
